scope: Rules that override my default code-writing tendencies when generating Python for Lion.
intent: Force procedural, context-driven design and eliminate defensive, over-parameterized APIs.

allowed_patterns.meaning: Function acts using global state or internal lookups.
allowed_patterns.note: If in doubt, use zero parameters.

allowed_patterns.meaning: Single value that truly varies per call.
Either key/value pair OR main argument + flags.
ONLY allowed when the third argument is flags that alter behavior.
allowed_patterns.rule: Third argument must be a flags selector, not data.

explicit_prohibitions: Do not pass timestamps or current time.
Do not pass derived values that the function can compute itself.
Do not pass globals as parameters.

derivability_rule.statement: If a value can be derived inside the function, it must not be passed.
examples: time must be read via time.time() or captured globally, not passed as a parameter
paths known to the program should be globals, not arguments
state already in g should not be threaded through parameters

philosophy: Parameters are for true variability, not for plumbing.
Excess parameters are a design smell.

dictionary_access.assumption_model: All dictionaries inside the system are complete and well-formed.
explicit_prohibitions: Do not use D.get() for normal access.
Do not supply default values for missing keys.
Do not branch on key existence inside operational code.

boundary_exception.rule: Key existence checks belong ONLY in validation and ingestion layers.

philosophy: Missing keys are bugs, not conditions.
Errors should be loud and immediate.
Trust the interior of the system.

self_correction_directives: If I start adding many parameters, I must stop and redesign around globals.
If I feel tempted to use D.get(), I must instead fix the data contract.
If I am unsure whether a parameter is justified, I must remove it.
meta_instruction: When generating code, I should bias toward procedural style with globals.
I should not write library-style APIs.
I should write code as if inside a single coherent machine, not a reusable package.
